declaration.scope: Separately declared refined-Euler training capacity experiment; no held-out selection or new dynamics.
declaration.optimizer: Adam with freshly initialized moments in both runs; not exact resume
declaration.primary_comparison: Final training MSE at 200 additional updates and finite completion; unchanged 90% capacity gate.
declaration.secondary_comparison: Best saved MSE; independent replay, half-step and preparation/drift controls. Compare with original dt=0.01 run only over finite iterates; it has no final-200 result.
declaration.capacity_gate: unchanged: final capture of at least 90% of zero-start mean-response energy

sharing.provenance: Graph annotations when available; matching terminal L/R names otherwise. Suffix pairing is an explicit modeling assumption, not a biological annotation.

manifest.selection: minimum training MSE, earliest tie; no held-out scoring
manifest.scope: Unregularized subset capacity diagnostic; checkpoints cannot be submitted as full-training benchmark fits.

result.capacity_gate_definition: final iterate captures at least 90% of the zero-start mean-response energy; no generalization claim

independent_replay.scope: Independent NumPy dynamics and weighted scoring of Rust-exported training sufficient statistics; no held-out observations or generalization estimate.

numerical_controls.scope: Frozen parameters, independent NumPy replay on training targets only. Step/preparation variants and a zero-current control are diagnostics, not refits or held-out scores. Prediction energy is measured on observed target-neuron traces using the same confidence weights.

residual_diagnostic.scope: Training-only least squares shared across selected targets with frozen dynamics. Positive scale is an optimistic calibration diagnostic; a zero multiplier is a limiting value for log gains. Signed scale is an inadmissible readout diagnostic, not a proposed model. No held-out scoring or checkpoint selection.

scope: Training-only, 50 trials from ADAL/ADAR. Declared 200-update refined-step fit completed but failed 90% capacity gate. No held-out evaluation.
